q1-phase1-wiring.title: Phase-1 runner cutoff wiring (leakage-relevant)
q1-phase1-wiring.imperative: Verify cutoff forwards into MAIN train + eval-range restriction + as-of-N prior; LOSO/calibration do NOT get cutoff; no-cutoff path unchanged.
q1-phase1-wiring.finding: VERIFIED leakage-correct. runner.py:142-146 forwards config.data.eval_year_train_through_round/eval_round_range ONLY into the MAIN train job via _module_train_args; runner.py:155-157 sets backtest_template.eval_round_range; runner.py:316-336 loads as-of-N prior with allow_same_season_research=config.runtime.allow_same_season_compound_prior and restricts SBR via _eval_round_race_names. runner_support.py:655 (calibration) and :809 (LOSO) call _module_train_args WITHOUT cutoff kwargs (default None) and their backtest templates omit eval_round_range. run.py:270-272/443-458 forward cutoff into prepare_module_training_data and round_filter into backtest batches. Consumption real: module_training_holdout_modes.py:48-102 _resolve_eval_year_split adds eval_year rounds 1..N to train pool with (1,N) window, restricts eval to range, and REJECTS range[0]<=cutoff (line 94). build_labeled_batches round filter applied at module_training_orchestration.py:576-578. No-cutoff path: both None -> (train_years,None,None) byte-identical (line 69-70). test_runner_cutoff_wiring.py asserts all of this on real code (6 tests).

q2-attestation.title: Attestation enforced
q2-attestation.imperative: Verify per-race train_max_round<R AND prior_through_round<R; violation FAILS; a test injects a leaking synthetic race and asserts failure.
q2-attestation.finding: VERIFIED enforced. attestation.py:41-50 flags train_max_round>=race_round AND prior_through_round>=race_round (strict >=, so cutoff==round leaks); :88-92 raises LeakageError naming every offender. orchestrator.py:200 calls attest_no_leakage(race_rows) UNCAUGHT in run(), so any violation aborts. Defensive: orchestrator.py:137-145 surfaces any out-of-range round the pipeline emits into rows so attestation sees it (no silent drop). Leak-injection test test_orchestrator.py:310-337 injects a round-6 prediction into P1 (cutoff=6) and asserts pytest.raises(LeakageError) on orch.run(); plus unit tests at :135-145 assert train/prior-at-or-after-race fail. Re-ran: 79 passed.

consolidation.summary: All 14 survey checks PASS. Phase-1 cutoff wiring is leakage-correct (cutoff reaches only the MAIN eval-year train job + eval-range restriction + as-of-N same-season prior; LOSO/calibration excluded; no-cutoff path byte-identical to gold). Per-race leakage attestation is hard-enforced (uncaught LeakageError) with a leak-injection test proving abort. Period definitions exact. Ascending-mean prediction-ordering rule reproduces promoted predictions[].rank exactly on real data (non-vacuous). verify_walkforward_run is a real gate. DB-only respected; simplification PASS(16). Scope clean: scoring_rules + params/gold untouched, no heavy run. Re-ran walkforward 79 / runner 24 / run-cli 28, all green. Two non-blocking triage candidates flagged.

triage_candidates.statement: Non-blocking robustness nit: orchestrator._p0_race_rows resolves promoted files via glob 'round{NN}_*.json' and takes matches[0], silently picking the first if >1 exist; the pipeline's _only() helper is stricter (fails on >1). Verified the real promoted dir has exactly one file per round 1-6, so G4 is unaffected. Consider tightening _find_promoted_file to fail on ambiguity for symmetry. Out of scope for this gate.

G4-watch (already flagged in design note, not a code defect): the SubprocessPipeline downstream chain (fusion->materialize->comparison, pipeline.py:254-308) has not run end-to-end; materialize_runtime_bundles auto-discovers the trained manifest by gold_cycle_->fusion_ slug swap and relies on gold+fusion sharing a timestamp. Step ORDER, CLI flags, slug discovery, and prediction extraction are unit-validated on pure parts, but the live slug handoff between steps 3-6 should be watched on the first real G4 run.
